today_news.title: Elevenlabs makes Music v2.5 available via app and API with free and pro tier options
today_news.summary: ElevenLabs has released Music v2.5 for its AI music generator. In a blind test with nearly 48,000 comparison pairs, listeners preferred the new version over its predecessor. The company says the model was trained only on licensed music.

today_news.title: Sam Altman calls for pacing AI development but promises rapid progress will continue
today_news.summary: Sam Altman is doubling down on slowing AI development. OpenAI now runs safety checks before major training runs, and according to The Information, the company has been talking with Anthropic and Google for months about joint self-regulation.
